content.subject: Kubernetes cost creep at Datadog's scale
content.opening_hook: With Datadog's headcount up 11% in the last year and your team in New York driving enterprise and mid-market growth, the pressure to justify cloud infrastructure spend while scaling sales capacity is real.
content.value_prop: We help observability-heavy teams reduce Kubernetes and cloud overhead by identifying spend inefficiencies that quietly compound as environments grow — without touching alert pipelines or slowing deployment cadence.
content.social_proof: We're an AWS Advanced Tier Partner with 6+ years of partnership and 25+ Databricks-certified resources, giving us deep context across the exact stack your engineering org runs.
content.cta: Would a focused 20-minute call this week make sense to explore whether there's a fit for your infrastructure cost goals?
content.reasoning: Rachel owns revenue growth at a publicly-traded company under increasing scrutiny to show efficient growth. Framing the pitch around Kubernetes cost optimization and cloud spend — directly tied to Datadog's own tech stack — makes this feel relevant, not generic. The AWS partnership proof point adds credibility without overselling.
content.body:
I'm Prashant Biswas from Ganit. We are a full-stack Data & AI company, recognized by Everest, Forrester, and Analytics India.

With Datadog's headcount up 11% in the last year and your team in New York driving enterprise and mid-market growth, the pressure to justify cloud infrastructure spend while scaling sales capacity is real.

We help observability-heavy teams reduce Kubernetes and cloud overhead by identifying spend inefficiencies that quietly compound as environments grow — without touching alert pipelines or slowing deployment cadence.

We're an AWS Advanced Tier Partner with 6+ years of partnership and 25+ Databricks-certified resources, giving us deep context across the exact stack your engineering org runs.

Would a focused 20-minute call this week make sense to explore whether there's a fit for your infrastructure cost goals?
